changes_from: verified-pilot-2.2 (2026-09-27). Adopts the research cross-origin potency rule (config/verified-indices-research-xo-potency.json, research/verified-indices/xo-potency-research-2026-09-27.md) as the public definition, with the same values: in the peptide stratum, a synthetic peptide with the same sequence measured by another paper from another origin (same target, endpoint, HHL substrate, uM, value in text) counts as an independent DOI for the single/multiple DOI factor and the BBVI independence check, when its pIC50 is within max_pIC50_gap of the species value. It never changes the species value (pIC50 stays the median of origin-species rows), never creates an item or a species row, and is not an origin claim. Only effect today: oyster (836033) LQP, Do et al. 2012 (origin) + Miyoshi et al. 1991 (synthetic LQP 2.0 uM, alpha-zein) -> MBPI 72.2 -> 96.3, BBVI withheld -> 80.9. Every other rule, factor, cohort, threshold and the other 29 species equal 2.2.

grade_notes.domestic_table: RDA row with a domestic source label such as ('16); per-value analysed/calculated status is not exposed online, so the row is not labelled 'measured'.
grade_notes.foreign_table_cited: RDA row whose source label names another national table, e.g. JAPAN('20) or USDA('18): same food, borrowed value. Pilot factor 0.85, same as 'calculated'.
grade_notes.measured/calculated/proxy: Kept from verified-pilot-1 for the AFCD cross-check rows.

Excludes organ/part-only rows, sex/region sub-sample rows and freshwater-farmed fish. Reference foods are not operating candidates.

primary_cohorts.criteria: RDA DB 10.4, group '해조류', raw rows with protein, iron and zinc all reported per 100 g edible portion. Dried, salted and blanched rows are excluded by the raw-only rule and never converted.
uncertainty: Only three raw seaweed rows report all three components; each rank step moves a percentile by about 33 points.

cross_check_cohorts.criteria: AFCD Release 3 rows F006288/F006289/F006291: three Australian aquacultured oyster species, raw shucked flesh (verified-pilot-1 primary cohort).
cross_check_cohorts.note: verified-pilot-1 result kept as a cross-check only; not averaged with the RDA result.

conservation.label: IUCN 기반 시범 MCUI, 출현 추세 교차검증 미완료

national_fact_rule: A reviewed national red-list category (NIBR 2024, Republic of Korea scope) is shown next to the IUCN global assessment as a fact. It never becomes MCUI; national and global scopes stay separate.

posthoc.calibration_note: No weight or formula was tuned in verified-pilot-2, so no case was used for calibration.

MBPI.criterion: Origin species of a marine-derived drug at or beyond clinical stage should rank above operating candidates.
MBPI.reason: No origin -> compound -> assay chain was collected for these species in this snapshot and no operating candidate has an MBPI, so there is nothing to rank against.

MCUI.criterion: Among candidates, a species whose current IUCN assessment cites fishing and uses criterion A (population reduction) should rank above one assessed without a reduction criterion.
MCUI.reason: A. japonicus (EN A2bd, fishing) 80 > T. pacificus (LC, needs updating) 10. Only two species have an MCUI, so this is a consistency check, not validation.

national_red_list.label: 한국 국가 평가 기반 시범 MCUI
national_red_list.accepted_basis: IUCN Red List Categories and Criteria, regional-level guidelines
national_red_list.legal_protection: A legal protection designation without a red-list category is shown as a fact and never scored.
national_red_list.taxon_rule: Only rows whose published name resolves to the same accepted WoRMS species; subspecies and separate species are not moved.
national_red_list.ranking_rule: Never ranked, pooled or plotted with IUCN-based MCUI; national and global scopes stay separate.

page_recheck.method: NIBR e-catalogue page images re-read for the list page and the index page of every scored row (viewer page = printed page + 2)

peptide_bioactivity.minimum_justification: 30 peers keep one rank step at about 3 percentile points; below that a single peer moves the score more than the 0.75 single-DOI discount.
peptide_bioactivity.value_scale: pIC50 = 6 - log10(IC50 in uM); higher is more potent
peptide_bioactivity.note: Peptides never enter the small-molecule (ChEMBL) strata; the same single/multiple DOI factors and max aggregation apply.

cross_origin_potency.gap_justification: Team research assumption: a tenfold IC50 difference is the usual spread between labs for the same HHL assay; larger gaps are treated as non-replication, not averaged.
cross_origin_potency.rule: Potency replication only: the origin claim (sequence found in the species' own material) still needs the species' paper.

reference_combination.label: 참고 통합값 · 독립 재현 미확인
reference_combination.rule: Only when MFPI and MBPI are both calculated and BBVI is withheld because the MBPI rests on fewer independent papers than bbvi.minimum_independent_mbpi_dois. Never computed from a single axis, never written to scores.BBVI, never placed in the matrix or any ranking.
